Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to compound_records on record_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, and activities to docs on doc_id. Filter to target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target organism = 'Homo sapiens', standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM', canonical_smiles is not null, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is not null. Return DISTINCT rows. Sort by all output columns.
